ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate ratio of 0.10 high-intensity (white scarring/marks) to 0.90 low-intensity (black pigmentation) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-grey to black substrate across both lobes. Right lobe contains high-density, contiguous white linear clusters concentrated in the central-lateral region. Left lobe contains sparse, discrete white focal spots and fine linear marks in the medial and upper-lateral quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 48 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire visible boundary. Left lobe trailing edge displays ~14 distinct pixel peaks; right lobe displays ~12 distinct peaks with amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for both lobes, sweeping progressively upward and outward from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected as small, roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered near the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, multi-line linear rake marks (approx. 4-6 parallel lines) on the right lobe. Shorter, unaligned linear white streaks present on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring on the right lobe; ragged, irregular distal tip on the left lobe suggesting past physical trauma or partial amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct hook-shaped white scar located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
